meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用天文专用 Python 库 Astropy 帮你写和调试天文数据处理代码,能转换天体坐标、换算单位、读写 FITS 文件等。
howto.when: 当任务涉及编写或调试天文数据分析代码,或需要用到天体坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学计算等 Astropy 功能时触发。

say.text: 用 Astropy 读取这个 FITS 文件的头信息和数据。
say.note: Claude 会打开文件并展示结构和关键头关键词。

say.text: 把坐标 (10.5, 41.2) 从 ICRS 转到银道坐标系。
say.note: Claude 用 SkyCoord 完成转换并输出银经银纬。

say.text: 用 Planck18 算红移 1.5 的光度距离。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the Astropy library for astronomy data code: transforming celestial coordinates, converting units, reading/writing FITS, and other Astropy tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement or debug astronomical data analysis code, especially when tasks involve coordinate conversions, FITS files, cosmology calculations, units, tables, or time with Astropy.

say_en.text: Read this FITS file and show its header and data using Astropy.
say_en.note: Claude opens the file and summarizes structure and key headers.

say_en.text: Convert coordinates (10.5, 41.2) from ICRS to Galactic.
say_en.note: Claude uses SkyCoord and applies the .galactic transform.

say_en.text: Calculate the luminosity distance at z=1.5 with Planck18.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.cosmology to compute the distance.
